content.text:
I can't recreate Sonic himself since he's a trademarked character, but here's an **original** speedy blue hedgehog mascot in the same spirit: spiky, fast, and full of attitude, with its own look (goggles, scarf, split eyes, teal sneakers).

```svg
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 400" width="400" height="400">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="fur" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#3b6cf6"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#1e3fae"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="scarf" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#ff9a3c"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#ff5e3a"/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- background + speed lines -->
  <rect width="400" height="400" fill="#eaf4ff"/>

    <line x1="20" y1="120" x2="110" y2="120"/>
    <line x1="10" y1="170" x2="90" y2="170"/>
    <line x1="30" y1="230" x2="120" y2="230"/>
    <line x1="15" y1="290" x2="100" y2="290"/>

  <!-- back spikes (swept left) -->

  <ellipse cx="232" cy="262" rx="22" ry="30" fill="#f6d9a8"/>

  <!-- legs -->
  <path d="M210 290 L185 335" stroke="#1e3fae" stroke-width="12" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- scarf knot -->
  <path d="M195 205 Q225 220 258 205 L255 222 Q225 235 196 222 Z" fill="url(#scarf)" stroke="#c2401f" stroke-width="3"/>

  <!-- head -->
